svg.title: Two-point log-log fit: negative slope, positive exponent
svg.desc: The given points are X=6, Y=0.60206 and X=8, Y=0.47712. A dashed triangle has horizontal change plus 2 and vertical change minus 0.12494. Slope is minus 0.06247 and the exponent is plus 0.06247. A hollow middle dot is an interpolated prediction, not another measurement.
